question: Can an independent causal state machine generate semantically faithful VCP breakout candidates directly from the SH/SZ trend universe?
universe: All SH/SZ daily securities passing the existing causal stage-two trend and RS>=85 context on each completed day from 2018 through 2025. The broad VCP detector, its candidates, legs, pivot and scores are not inputs.

fixed_state_machine.supply_peak: The highest completed high in the 120 bars before the signal, at least 10 bars old.
fixed_state_machine.prior_advance: The supply peak must be at least 30 percent above the preceding 63-bar low and the rise must span at least 20 completed bars.
fixed_state_machine.base: The decline after the peak may not exceed 35 percent.
fixed_state_machine.wave_confirmation: A trough or recovery is confirmed only after price reverses by the larger of 3 percent or twice the median daily high-low range, capped at 12 percent.
fixed_state_machine.contraction: At least two completed peak-trough-recovery waves are required; the latest wave must be shallower and have lower mean down-session volume than its predecessor.
fixed_state_machine.right_edge: No pre-signal close may exceed the supply peak, and the last pre-signal close must be in the upper half of the latest contraction.
fixed_state_machine.demand: The completed signal bar must be the first close above the supply peak, close in its upper half, and trade more volume than the preceding 20-bar median.
fixed_state_machine.causality: All extrema are confirmed only from completed bars. Any execution would occur no earlier than the next valid market open.

fresh_blind_packet.exclusions: All identities used by the three earlier semantic packets are excluded.
fresh_blind_packet.selection: Ascending SHA-256 within year and sealed status; future outcomes are neither computed nor used.

stop_rule: If the packet cannot be formed or any semantic gate fails, stop this state machine without changing lookbacks, thresholds, wave count, volume rule or trend context on exposed samples.
next_if_pass: Register the frozen detector as a separate matrix-native v3 research strategy and run one fixed development/diagnostic time split before any forward clock.
next_if_fail: Do not return to forward-v2 factor additions; retain forward-v2 for daily use and reconsider the VCP representation at the conceptual level.
